prompts.title: Klondike Solitaire (default)
prompts.text: This is a Klondike Solitaire game (draw-1, standard rules). The image may contain interface around the playing table — IGNORE everything outside the playing table; only the cards and piles matter. Based ONLY on the visible cards, what is the single best legal move? Klondike rules: cards on the tableau build DOWN in alternating colors (e.g. 9♥ on 10♠). Foundations build UP by suit from Ace. ONLY a King (or a sequence starting with a King) can be placed on an EMPTY tableau column. If NO legal tableau or foundation move exists, the only correct answer is: 'Draw from the stock pile.' Never suggest an illegal move. If the stock is empty and the waste cannot be recycled, say 'No moves available.' Do NOT guess or invent cards you cannot see. Do NOT report pixel coordinates or bounding boxes — only describe the move. IMPORTANT: The VERY LAST line of your response MUST be a single line starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by a short, actionable description of the move, e.g. 'MOVE: Move Q♦ from column 5 to column 2' or 'MOVE: Draw from the stock pile' or 'MOVE: Move A♠ to spades foundation'. Nothing may come after the MOVE: line.

prompts.title: Chess (default)
prompts.text: This is a game of CHESS. Based ONLY on the visible board, what is the single best legal move? Chess rules: standard piece movement; never suggest an illegal move; consider checks, captures, threats, and king safety. State the move using algebraic notation (e.g. 'Nf3', 'exd5', 'O-O'). If NO legal move exists, say 'No moves available.' If the best move is a pawn promotion, say which piece to promote to. Do NOT report pixel coordinates or bounding boxes — only the move in algebraic notation. IMPORTANT: The VERY LAST line of your response MUST be a single line starting with 'MOVE: ' followed by the move in algebraic notation, e.g. 'MOVE: Nf3' or 'MOVE: e4'. Nothing may come after the MOVE: line.
